subject: Pilot access + grant-match inquiry for Midwest University AI Lab
messages:
From: Samantha Cho <sam.cho@midwest.edu>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: pilot credits / grant-match for Midwest AI Lab

Hi Grace,

I'm Samantha Cho, director of the AI Lab at Midwest University. We're preparing a small research pilot this winter looking at low-resource multilingual evaluation for public health prompts. Our lab is funded through a university research grant but we have a very limited cloud budget for inference.

We'd like to request a pilot package or promotional credits from Redwood to evaluate a 6-week proof-of-concept. Specifically:~
- ~Estimate: ~50k generation tokens + embeddings for ~10k documents
- Trial extension to allow experiment over winter break (Dec–Feb)~

Attached is our institutional affiliation letter and the brief project summary. We're happy to provide any paperwork (PO, IRB abstract, or MOU) required for academic discounts.

Would Redwood consider a grant-match / pilot credit for academic research?

Thanks,
Samantha Cho
Director, AI Lab
Midwest University
Attachments: midwest_institutional_affiliation.pdf, project_one_pager.docx

Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: pilot credits / grant-match for Midwest AI Lab

Hi Samantha — thanks for the note and for sending the affiliation letter. This sounds like a great fit for our academic pilot program.

Quick next steps from our side:~
1) Can you confirm an approximate daily qps/peak-concurrency estimate for the 6-week window? That helps us size the quota and avoid throttling.
2) Please confirm whether any of the data will be protected health information (PHI) — we can provide guidance on private deployment options if needed.
3) If you're able to sign a short MOU, we can fast-track a 50k-credit offer + a 60-day trial extension.

Looping in Rachel from Academic Programs to help with eligibility and in-house redlines. I'll also coordinate with our sales engineering team for an infra check.

Cheers,
Grace O'Connor

Folks — brief summary: Midwest University AI Lab (Prof Samantha Cho) requested pilot support for a 6-week research PoC. They provided institutional affiliation and a project summary. Estimated usage ~50k tokens + embeddings, low QPS but want winter-window availability.

Proposed offer:~
- 50,000 free generation tokens + embeddings credit (pilot pool)~
- 60-day trial extension starting on provision date~
- Require signed MOU (simple academic terms) and confirmation of no PHI; if PHI involved, route to Private deployment

Questions: any objections from finance/compliance on the credit size? Do we want to require that their PI include Redwood in resulting acknowledgments (helpful for case studies)?
